extraction_qa_warnings.message: The matched-cohort DHP-CCB cell is printed as 1,069 (50.2%), which is arithmetically inconsistent with n=5,285; the value is preserved as printed and not silently corrected.

Supplementary material was not specified by the task and was not fetched. Results quoted in the main text from supplementary tables were extracted only from the primary article text.
